name: tabellar
description: A personal email agent that runs on your Mac
author: George Nasseem

scripts.start: npm run build && node server/tabellar.ts start
scripts.build:server: rm -rf dist && tsc -p server --noEmit false --outDir dist --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server && tsc -p plus && npm run typecheck --workspace tabellar-frontend
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run build:server
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "import('./server/config.ts').then((c) => { if (!c.BUILT_IN_GOOGLE.clientId) { console.error('Fill in BUILT_IN_GOOGLE in server/config.ts before publishing.'); process.exit(1); } })"
